StepDescription: Launch Lorenzo Application
Login with valid credentials
Wait for home page to load after login
-- NAVIGATE TO PATIENT REGISTRATION --
Click Patients tab on home page to navigate to patient management area
Wait for Patients tab to load
Generate a random surname for unique new patient registration
Enter generated surname in the patient search form to confirm no existing record
Click Find to search for patients with the generated surname
Wait for patient search results to confirm no existing record
Click Registration to initiate new patient registration roadmap from search results
Wait for patient registration roadmap form to load
-- PATIENT REGISTRATION ROADMAP - SECTION 1: PERSON DETAILS --
Enter patient forename in the registration form
Enter patient surname in the registration form using generated random surname
Enter patient city of residence in the registration address fields
Select patient country of residence in the registration address fields
Click Next to proceed to the second section of the registration roadmap
-- PATIENT REGISTRATION ROADMAP - SECTION 2: ADDITIONAL DEMOGRAPHICS --
Wait for the next section of the registration roadmap to load
Select patient country of birth for demographic information
Select patient nationality for demographic information
Select patient ethnicity as a required demographic field
Click Finish to complete the patient registration roadmap and submit all details
Wait for NHS number allocation confirmation prompt
Click Yes to confirm NHS number allocation for the newly registered patient
Wait for visitor status question prompt
Click No to confirm patient is not a visitor so NHS number is permanently assigned
Wait for registration confirmation popup containing allocated NHS number
Capture NHS number from registration confirmation message for reference
Validate NHS number: Verify confirmation message text is not empty confirming NHS number was allocated
Click OK to dismiss the registration confirmation popup
Wait for home page to reload after patient registration is complete
-- NAVIGATE TO PATIENT EPR AND CREATE REFERRAL --
Click Find Record to search for the registered patient by surname
Wait for patient basic search form to load
Enter the registered patient surname to locate the newly created record
Click Find to search for the registered patient
Wait for patient search results to load
Click patient surname link to open the patient EPR view
Wait for the patient EPR view to load
Validate EPR view loaded: Verify patient PAS ID label is present in the EPR view
Capture patient PAS ID from EPR view for use in referral and contact workflows
-- CREATE REFERRAL FOR PATIENT --
Click Referrals tab in EPR view to navigate to the referrals section
Wait for the referrals section to load in EPR view
Click Create Referral to initiate a new referral for this patient
Wait for the Create Referral form to load
Select the service type for the referral
Select the referral source indicating who initiated the referral
Select the referral priority to indicate urgency
Select the referral type for classification
Click Finish Now to complete the referral creation
Wait for the Additional Options dialog to appear after referral creation
Click Cancel to dismiss the Additional Options dialog and return to EPR view
Wait for EPR view to reload after referral creation is complete
-- NAVIGATE TO CARE EVENTS EPR VIEW --
Click the EPR tabs down arrow to expand the full list of available EPR tabs
Wait for the EPR tab list to expand
Click the Care Events tab from the expanded EPR tab list to navigate to Care Events view
Wait for the Care Events page to load
-- CREATE SINGLE CONTACT - PLANNED --
Click Create Single Contact from the Care Events task pane to initiate a planned contact
Wait for the Create Single Contact form to load
Select the purpose of the planned contact
Select the contact type for the planned single contact
Select the contact subject for the planned single contact
Select the consultation medium indicating how the contact will be conducted
Select the location type for the planned contact
Click Next to proceed to the date and time step of the Create Single Contact wizard
Wait for the next step of the Create Single Contact wizard to load
Click Finish Now to complete the Create Single Contact wizard and save as Planned
Wait for the document template selection dialog to appear
Click Cancel to dismiss the document template dialog and return to Care Events
Wait for the Care Events page to reload after creating the planned contact
-- VALIDATE PLANNED STATUS --
Validate Planned status: Verify the contact event status shows Planned in the Care Events grid
-- SELECT PLANNED ENCOUNTER AND RECORD CONTACT - ACTUAL --
Select the planned encounter row from the Care Events grid to enable context pane actions
Wait for the Care Events context pane to update with the selected planned encounter
Click Record Contact from the Care Events task pane to record an actual contact for the planned encounter
Wait for the Record Contact form to load
Select the purpose of the actual contact being recorded
Select the contact type for the actual contact
Select the contact subject for the actual contact
Select the consultation medium for how the actual contact was conducted
Select the location type for the actual contact
Select the outcome of the actual contact
Click Next to proceed to the date and time step of the Record Contact wizard
Wait for the next step of the Record Contact wizard to load with date and time fields
Click Finish Now to complete the Record Contact wizard and save the actual contact
Wait for the confirmation dialog to appear after recording the actual contact
Click Yes to confirm and finalise the actual contact recording
Wait for the Care Events page to reload after recording the actual contact
-- VALIDATE ACTUAL STATUS AFTER RECORD CONTACT --
Validate Actual status: Verify the patient event status has updated to Actual in the Care Events grid after Record Contact
-- SELECT ACTUAL ENCOUNTER AND MODIFY CONTACT - ACTUAL --
Select the actual encounter row from the Care Events grid to enable modify contact action
Wait for the Care Events context pane to update with the selected actual encounter
Click Modify Contact from the Care Events task pane to modify the actual encounter
Wait for the Modify Contact form to load with the existing contact details
Select the updated purpose for the modified contact
Select the updated contact type for the modified contact
Select the updated contact subject for the modified contact
Select the updated consultation medium for the modified contact
Select the updated location type for the modified contact
Select the updated outcome for the modified contact
Click Next to proceed to the date and time step of the Modify Contact wizard
Wait for the next step of the Modify Contact wizard to load
Click Finish Now to complete the Modify Contact wizard and close the actual encounter
Wait for the confirmation dialog to appear after modifying the contact
Click Yes to confirm and finalise the modified contact
Wait for the Care Events page to reload after modifying the actual contact
-- VALIDATE ACTUAL ENCOUNTER CLOSED AND STATUS UPDATED --
Validate Actual encounter closed: Verify the patient event status remains Actual in the Care Events grid confirming the encounter is closed
-- VALIDATE ENCOUNTER LIST AND DETAILS --
Click to expand the care event row in the list to view sub-encounters
Wait for the care event row to expand showing encounter sub-items
Click on the Care Event Details link to open the full encounter detail view
Wait for the care event detail panel to load with all encounter metadata

Validate Encounter Details: Verify that the encounter detail labels (Health Organisation, Encounter Type, Care Provider, Specialty, Start Date, End Date, Encounter ID, Care Provider Role) are visible in the detail panel
-- VALIDATE PATIENT EVENT STATUS LIST AND DETAILS --
Validate Patient Event Status List: Verify the patient event status in the Care Events list shows Actual confirming all encounters are in the correct status
-- RECORD QUICK CONTACT - ACTUAL --
Unselect the currently selected encounter row before initiating Quick Contact
Click Record Quick Contact from the Care Events task pane to record an immediate actual contact
Wait for the Record Quick Contact form to load
Select the purpose for the quick contact
Select the contact type for the quick contact
Select the location type for the quick contact
Click Select Existing Referral icon to associate this quick contact with the created referral
Wait for the referral search results to load in the selection dialog
Click Select to add the existing referral to the quick contact
Wait for the quick contact form to reload with the selected referral populated
Select the outcome for the quick contact
Click Finish Now to complete the Record Quick Contact wizard and save the actual contact
Wait for the Care Events page to reload after recording the quick contact
-- VALIDATE QUICK CONTACT ACTUAL STATUS --
Validate Quick Contact Actual status: Verify the patient event status shows Actual in the Care Events grid after recording the quick contact
-- LOGOUT --
Click Logout button to initiate logout from Lorenzo application
Confirm logout by clicking Yes on the logout confirmation dialog
